status: PROPOSAL ONLY: not frozen, not run. No outcome column of the Vis 2024 release has been read by anyone in this repository. The parent decides whether to freeze and run it; nothing below authorises an outcome read.

decision_context.jaaks_primary: EXPLORATORY_WORTHWHILE_EXCLUDED on Jaaks E lines: R - C_mean (fp 30) relative -5.96% [-13.36%, +1.67%], 110.5 vs 117.5 confirmed (reproduced exactly by verify). Under contract v2 this means STOP pursuing R as a confirmation-aware improvement over C*.
decision_context.consequence_for_this_proposal: an untouched study is NOT needed to continue R (the registered rule says stop). It is proposed only as (a) an untouched check that the STOP decision is not specific to Jaaks's orientation-swap verification, on a different verification kind (same ordered combination re-measured in an independent screening run), and (b) the only qualifying untouched evaluation found for the narrower estimand. If the parent accepts the STOP as final, this plan can be archived unrun; the data stay untouched.

source.release: Vis DJ, Jaaks P, ..., Garnett MJ, Wessels LFA. Cell Rep Med 2024;5:101687 (DOI 10.1016/j.xcrm.2024.101687), Data S1 = mmc7.zip/data-code/SupplementalMaterials/pancan_combi_fitted_data_jan21.tsv.gz
source.never_open_before_stage_2: Tables S2-S5 (mmc3-mmc6: outcome classifications for all lines including E) and every outcome column of E rows

estimand: On new cell lines of the eligible tissues, with the 19-combination menu, the H history library and a registered 20% measurement cap, two rounds: does ranking by the history-derived shrunk joint confirmation rate R give more measured confirmed discoveries than the strongest simple same-information ranking C*? Screen = the measurement of an ordered combination (anchor, library) in one screening project; confirmation = the same ordered combination at identical anchor and library concentrations on different plates of the other project (cross-run repeat; same compounds, same assay, same day-4 readout; cell-line batch disjoint in 22% of line x candidate cells). This is NOT the Jaaks orientation-swap estimand; it is the same-condition cross-run confirmation estimand.

menu.candidates: the 19 ordered combinations in verify/design_census_vis_menu.json (measured in both GDSC_002 and GDSC_005 drug sets with identical anchor concentrations and library maximum concentration); MK-1775 + temozolomide excluded (anchor concentration differs between projects)
menu.per_line: candidates with both project measurements present after the authors' QC (QC-conditioned menu, as contract v2 limitation M1; the count of design-menu candidates removed by QC is reported per line)

partition.rule: eligible lines: complete 19-menu (pre-QC) in tissues with >= 10 such lines (20 tissues, 710 lines; Prostate 7, Biliary 5, Testis 3, Uterus 3, Adrenal 1, Vulva 1 excluded). Every line present in the Jaaks 2022 release (109) goes to H; the other lines of each tissue are permuted with default_rng([20261004, 99, tissue rank]) and min(floor(n_t/2), n_non_Jaaks) go to E.
partition.counts: E = 298 lines (Lung 67, Haematopoietic 64, CNS 18, Bone 17, Esophagus 15, Ovary 15, Skin 15, Head and Neck 13, PNS 11, Stomach 11, Bladder 8, Kidney 8, Soft Tissue 8, Liver 7, Thyroid 7, Cervix 6, Endometrium 5, Large Intestine 2, Pancreas 1, Breast 0); H = 412 (incl. 109 Jaaks lines: Breast 43, Large Intestine 38, Pancreas 28); E lines with disjoint CL batches for every candidate: 54

staged_access.vault: a new freeze file listing this plan, the builder, the analysis code and the partition with their sha256 and the fitted TSV digest; every outcome read through tools.datasets.combination_screens.open_vault with a logged purpose (stage 1 / stage 2), as in this study's common.exposed_ticket
staged_access.stage_0: exposed Jaaks only: gate G1 (call-rule reproduction); no Vis outcome
staged_access.stage_1: Vis H lines only: the builder streams the TSV in chunks and drops every row whose SIDM is not in H before any outcome column is converted or retained; it asserts that no E SIDM is present in its output and logs the row counts. Gates G2-G4, C*/fp* selection and the power projection are computed here and written (hashed) before stage 2.
staged_access.stage_2: only after the parent freezes the stage-1 outputs: E rows, primary analysis exactly as frozen; one run; no re-run with changed code (addendum otherwise)

builder.rows: RESEARCH_PROJECT in {GDSC_002-A, GDSC_002-B, GDSC_005-A, GDSC_005-B}; (ANCHOR_ID, LIBRARY_ID) in the 19-menu; project = RESEARCH_PROJECT without the arm suffix (A/B arms split lines; they are not replicates)
builder.qc: authors' rule as the frozen Jaaks builder: drop rows with SYNERGY_RMSE > 0.2 or LIBRARY_RMSE > 0.2 or a missing SYNERGY_DELTA_EMAX, SYNERGY_OBS_EMAX, SYNERGY_DELTA_XMID or SYNERGY_XMID_uM; counts recorded
builder.row_call: synergistic iff SYNERGY_XMID_uM < 2 x maxc and (SYNERGY_DELTA_XMID >= 3 or SYNERGY_DELTA_EMAX >= 0.2) (screening documentation: combo IC50 below twice the top library concentration and a >= 8-fold IC50 shift or >= 0.2 Emax shift). The Vis release has no Synergy column, so the sign and unit conventions are validated by G1 and G2 before use.
builder.measurement_call: per (line, ordered combination, project, anchor concentration): synergistic if >= half of replicate rows are; per (line, ordered combination, project): hit if synergistic at either anchor concentration (authors' rule)
builder.label: 100 x max over anchor concentrations of the mean SYNERGY_DELTA_EMAX (as the Jaaks builder)
builder.roles: AB: screen = GDSC_002 measurement, verification = GDSC_005 measurement; BA: swapped. role index AB = 0, BA = 1; line value = mean of the two (paired, one unit)
builder.assertions: screen and verification barcodes of every candidate disjoint; AB verification arrays equal BA screen arrays; menu rows in the registered order

predictors_and_policy: exactly contract v2 (protocol/campaign_contract.json): history rows H(t, r) = menu rows of the target tissue's H lines (E target) or the other H lines (H target), both projects; pooled quantities over H; k0 = 2; R (p_sv / p_v|s), S_both, L_v, C_s, C_v, C_mean, C_prod, S; P2 with M = (menu + 4) // 5 (19 -> 4), n1 = ((100 - fp) x M) // 100; tie-break default_rng([20261004, tissue_code, line_index, role_index]) with tissue_code = 1 + rank of the tissue in the sorted eligible list and line_index = position in the builder's per-tissue sorted line tuple; verify-workstream implementation (verify/independent_check.py, exact match with the design implementation on Jaaks) reusable without change except the builder.

selection.primary: contract v2 procedure applied on Vis H lines only (leave-one-line-out within H of each tissue): C* = best of {S_both, L_v, C_s, C_v, C_mean, C_prod} at its best fp (ties: smaller fp; listed order), fp* = C*'s best fp; written and hashed in stage 1
selection.secondary: Jaaks-frozen C* = C_mean, fp* = 30 (no Vis selection)

primary_contrast: R - C* on the 298 E lines under P2 at fp*
inference: contract v2 bootstrap (default_rng(20261004), 10,000 resamples, numpy.percentile linear), strata = eligible tissues with >= 4 E lines in sorted name order, the remaining E lines (Large Intestine 2, Pancreas 1) pooled into one stratum 'other' placed last
decision_rules: contract v2 table with tau = 0.05 and the prefix UNTOUCHED_ (HARM U < 0; WORTHWHILE_EXCLUDED 0 <= U < tau and L <= 0; SMALL_BENEFIT L > 0 and U < tau; BENEFIT_DETECTED 0 < L <= tau <= U; WORTHWHILE L > tau; UNRESOLVED L <= 0 and U >= tau)

gates_before_stage_2.G1_call_rule: stage 0, exposed Jaaks release: the row_call formula on Jaaks's own columns (SYNERGY_XMID_uM, LIBRARY_CONC as maxc, SYNERGY_DELTA_XMID, SYNERGY_DELTA_EMAX) reproduces its Synergy column on >= 99% of QC-passing rows; otherwise STOP and report
gates_before_stage_2.G2_convention: stage 1, the 109 H lines also in Jaaks: per (line, ordered combination, anchor concentration) at identical concentrations, the Vis derived call agrees with the Jaaks call with Cohen's kappa > 0.2 and the Vis and Jaaks delta-Emax labels correlate with r > 0.3; otherwise STOP (unit or sign convention mismatch)
gates_before_stage_2.G3_menu: stage 1: >= 15 of 19 candidates survive QC in >= 90% of H lines; report the share of H campaigns with >= 1 joint hit
gates_before_stage_2.G4_power: stage 1: run P2 on H targets (leave-one-line-out within H) at fp* for R and C*; SD of the paired line difference and mean C* yield give the projected 95% relative half-width hw = 1.96 x SD / (mean x sqrt(298)); written before stage 2. If hw > 0.10 the parent is told that only effects beyond about +-10% can be resolved (UNRESOLVED is the expected verdict for small effects) and decides whether to open E.

power_planning: not computable from design counts. Jaaks E (M about 28, mean 1.93 confirmed per line) had SD/mean about 0.30 for R - C_mean; with M = 4 (two screens, two verification slots) yields are small counts and SD/mean is expected about 0.7-1.5, giving hw about 8-17% at n_E = 298: detection of a gain >= ~15-20% or harm, not demonstration or exclusion of tau = 5%. Stating this now so that a later UNRESOLVED verdict is not read as evidence of no effect.
registered_sensitivities_descriptive: E restricted to the 54 lines with disjoint cell-line batches for every candidate
excluding E lines with replicate plates inside a project
P3 and the 1/2/3-round frontier as in contract v2
concordance AUC of the screen score with the joint call (contract metric definitions)
limitations: fitted values come from one hierarchical model run that shares cell-line parameters across the two projects (both measurements are not statistically independent; same as Jaaks SV/VS)
same cell-line batch in 78% of line x candidate cells; no seeding or scan dates in the release (one fit time stamp 2021-01-12)

menu of 19 ordered combinations (15 of them involve trametinib, taselisib or lapatinib; the other 4 are olaparib + temozolomide and AZD7762 with cisplatin, 5-fluorouracil or MK-1775): estimand is this menu, not a general library
estimand is cross-run repeat confirmation, not orientation swap; a null here does not test the Jaaks orientation question and vice versa
